title: Bombay High Court (special bench, Justices G.S. Kulkarni and Advait M. Sethna, order of Tue 10 Nov 2026) orders CBI, ED (PMLA) and Income Tax probes into Pune's Sinhgad Technical Education Society, its 44 institutions and trustees after about 220 staff petitions over salary and terminal dues unpaid for almost eight years, stated to exceed ₹400 crore; accounts frozen, trustees' passports deposited, contempt show-cause notices after the ₹60.65 crore pre-Diwali undertaking of 6 Nov went unpaid; court sees a strong prima facie case of siphoning (allegations unproven); Education Dept to take over schools or move students; administrators for technical colleges; first reports due 19 Nov
